about: module simd's mutants (U1 SIMD-SCAN); each is judged by the module's laws (examples:modules/simd). The kernels run only in a vector build, so env sets GOEXPERIMENT=simd for every run of this ledger's suite; the stock build's kernels are the scalar loop, held by the same laws without it. The law that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: simd-tail-dropped
mutants.rule: The scalar tail after the last whole vector is scanned: scan.IndexByteKernelIsTheReference (needle after 0 to 127 filler bytes).

mutants.rule: Mask bit k is byte k, so the first match is the lowest bit: scan.IndexByteKernelIsTheReference.

mutants.name: simd-any2-second-dropped
mutants.rule: Either needle ends the scan: scan.IndexAny2KernelIsTheReference.

mutants.name: simd-outside-hi-dropped
mutants.rule: A byte above hi is outside: scan.IndexOutsideKernelIsTheReference.

mutants.name: simd-count-tail-dropped
mutants.rule: The tail's bytes are counted: scan.CountByteKernelIsTheReference.

mutants.rule: A kernel reads no byte after its slice's length: a slice whose capacity runs on into an unreadable page faults on a read one past the end.

mutants.name: quote-tail-misses-control
mutants.rule: A control byte in the last partial block needs escape: scan.QuoteScanKernelIsTheReference.

mutants.name: quote-vector-misses-control
mutants.rule: Every control byte is caught in a whole block: scan.QuoteScanKernelIsTheReference.

mutants.name: quote-html-dropped
mutants.rule: With html, '<', '>' and '&' end the safe run in a whole block: scan.QuoteScanKernelIsTheReference.

mutants.name: quote-reads-one-past
mutants.rule: The quote scan reads no byte after its slice's length.
